note: Driven by scripts/download_models.py (idempotent). License is RECORDED, never a download gate. Group order matters: earlier groups are higher priority.

groups.flux-core: Starter: FLUX.2 klein-4B full set (Apache-2.0, ungated). Wired into workflows/flux2-txt2img@v1.json.
groups.sdxl-rails: SDXL rails layer: region-control recipe + attribute-carry, and the SDXL models the Krita AI Diffusion plugin expects. Not the starter family.
groups.krita-sd15: SD1.5 models the Krita AI Diffusion plugin checks for (its SD1.5 workflows + shared upscalers). Not used by Crexil's presets.
groups.deferred: Listed for completeness; not downloaded by default.
groups.zimage: Z-Image family: Turbo sketch engine + LoRA-capable Base. Apache-2.0 (Tongyi-MAI upstream; Comfy-Org single-file repack). Text encoder reuses flux-core's qwen_3_4b.safetensors; VAE is the FLUX.1 autoencoder (ae.safetensors).
groups.qwen-edit: Edit backend: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (20B instruction-edit, fp8mixed fits 24 GB). Apache-2.0 upstream (Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, verified 2026-07-26); Comfy-Org repacks. Z-Image-Edit recorded UNAVAILABLE when this group was added (no released weights; WATCH for release).
groups.3d-mesh: 3D lane engines (scripts-first under tools/3d/): TRELLIS.2-4B + Hunyuan3D 2.1 + conditioners. NOT driven by this downloader: weights live in the HF cache (~/models/hf), revisions pinned in tools/3d/pins.json; entries here are the license ledger (managed_by marks them; download_models.py skips them).
